report:
Trouvailles:

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité. 

Il y a un léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage impliquant les trois compartiments plus proéminents au niveau du compartiment interne. Il n'y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet. 

Il y a de légers changements dégénératifs intra-substances impliquant le corps à la corne postérieure du ménisque interne. Il n'y a pas de déchirure linéaire bien définie. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité. 

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et le tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibial sont sans particularité.

Conclusion:

1- Légers changements dégénératifs plus proéminents au niveau du compartiment interne tels que décrits ci-haut.

2- Changements dégénératifs intra-substances impliquant le ménisque interne sans déchirure linéaire bien définie.

3- Petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. Small osseous contusion at the posterior lateral tibial plateau. No fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Complete, subacute tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Borderline tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Complete, subacute tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
2. Small osseous contusion at the posterior lateral tibial plateau.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> The contour of ACL is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Subcutaneonus infiltration over anterior aspect of left knee, major at medial side.
> Wearing of articular cartilage of left patella, major at medial facet and patellar ridge, reflecting grade 3 chondromalacia; spur formation of patella.
    Wearing of articular cartilage of femoral trochlea, major at medial side, reflecting grade 2-3 chondromalacia
> Mild bone marrow edema over  medial aspect of patella abutting meidal retinaculum attachment
> Interstitial increased signal intensity of medial patellar retinaculum, R/O grade 1-2 injury.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of  grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or contusion.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.

Impression: 
1. Subcutaneous edema over anterior aspect of left knee, C/W echymosis.
2. Mild bone contusion of medial aspect of patella.
3. R/O grade 1-2 injury of medial patellar retinaculum.
4. Osteoarthritis of left patellofemoral joint with grade 3 chondromalacia.
5. Grade 1 ACL injury.
6. Grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or contusion.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, there is focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the medial trochlea (about intact8*intact7 cm). The patellar cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the medial trochlea (about intact8*intact7 cm). 
  Intact menisci and ligaments of right knee.

МР находка: Лява колянна става: МР данни за изразени дегенеративни изменения в лявата колянна става. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е изцяло лизиран. От латералната страна се виждат дефекти в ставния хрущял срединно.  Сравнително запазен е хрущяла на пателата. МР данни за масивни остеофити по кондилите на фемура и тибията. Сравително по-малки остеофити се изобразяват и в горния и долен край на пателата. Изострени са интеркондиларните еминенциии. Наличие на ставен излив с хетерогенно съдържимо, вероятно хемартроза.  МР данни за руптура на предната кръстна връзка с давност. Задната кръстна връзка е интактна. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Визуализират се тежки дегенеративни промени в двата менискуса –латералния менискус е с белези на парциална увреда и е експулсиран встряни, докато медиалният менискус е дегенерирал изцяло и не се визуализира. Изобразяват се част от фрагментиран заден рог на медиалния менискус. Наличие на субкортикални костни кисти – геоди в медиалния кондил на фемура  и на нивото на интеркондиларните еминенции. Визуализират се вкалцявания в меките тъкани дорзално от тибията. Заключение: МР данни за напреднала гонартроза, по-изразена от медиалната страна. Дегенеративна промяна в двата менискуса. Фрагментиран е задния рог на медиалния менискус, латералния е експулсиран встрани. Руптура на предната кръстна връзка с давност. Ставен излив с белези на хемартроза. В ДД плана по-малко вероятно е да се касае за първична синовиална хондроматоза.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 2 months of right knee pain, hyperextension on fishing trip
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Diffuse cortical thickening and sclerosis with trabecular prominence. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Full-thickness radial tear of the posterior root with mild extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Areas of full thickness fissuring in the medial compartment.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness chondral fissuring the central trochlea. Maintenance of the patellar cartilage. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Edema surrounding the MCL consistent with g1 sprain
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Low grade strain of the vastus medialis muscle belly. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Full thickness radial tear of the posterior root of the medial meniscus with mild extrusion.
2. Moderate trochlear and medial compartment chondrosis. 
3. Diffuse cortical thickening and trabecular prominence which may be on the basis of Paget's disease or other metabolic bone etiology. Recommend correlation with radiography.

Geringes Knochenmarksödem im lateralen Tibiaplateau. Das Außenband gering aufgetrieben mit Signalanhebung in ödemsensitiven Sequenzen, jedoch strukturell intakt. Kreuzbänder ohne Läsionen. Außenmeniskus extrudiert stehend mit geringem Ödemssignal im Vorderhorn (4/21). Innenmeniskushinterhorn mukoid degeneriert ohne Rissbildung (5/7). Regelrechte Signalgebung des medialen Kollateralbandes. Kleine fokale Chondropathie am lateralen Femurkondylus (4/25). Ausgedünnter Knorpelbesatz im lateralen Kompartiment. Lateral und suprapatellar betonter Gelenkerguss. Baker-Zyste mit einem CC-Maß von 5 cm.

Bei geringer Pangonarthrose lateral randständig in der Belastungszone subchondrales Knochenödem femoral bei fokal hochgradiger Chondropathie mit subchondraler Linienbildung, DD kleine Infraktionen/SIF möglich. Weiteres Ödem randständig tibial medialseitig (5/15) bei im medialen Kompartiment oberflächlichen Knorpelirregularitäten. Retropatellararthrose mit sowohl fokal an den Condylenwangen sowie femorpatellar lateral führend teils flächig hochgradige, vollschichtige Chondropathie mit teils subchondraler Zysten-/Ödembildung und kleinem chondralen Osteophyten. Geringe mukoide Veränderungen der Meniscen ohne umschriebene Rissbildung. Bandapparat intakt. Geringer Gelenkerguss, geringe Reizsynovialitis.
